now-playing.title: Now Playing
now-playing.description: The playing track on the strip, hidden while nothing plays; pause and skip from the popover.

store.tagline: Play, pause and skip Spotify, Music, a browser or any MPRIS player
features: One row per running player: the track, artist and album, the artwork, a `playing` / `paused` / `stopped` tag
macOS: every player the system's Now Playing sees (a browser, VLC), through the bundled MediaRemote adapter, on macOS 15.4 and later too
`enter` plays or pauses and the tag follows; `cmd+right` and `cmd+left` skip
`cmd+c` copies `artist - title`; `cmd+o` opens the track (Spotify's `spotify:track:` link) or the app
Live: the current track is a root result, so its title or artist finds it without opening the palette
A bar item with the playing track and the transport in its popover, refreshed within seconds of a skip
